caption:
Three ways to say congrats

I used to answer a friend's good news by steering to my own. Then I started saying so proud of you.

People tend to remember the first reaction to their good news, so a plain and warm one counts for a lot.

For whoever celebrates the news before anything else.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table and a royal blue figure that says I got the job. with happy eyes, in three labeled scenes. The one-up: a teal figure says me too! and the blue one narrows its eyes. The flat one: a brown figure says cool. with narrowed eyes and the blue one looks down. The cheer: an ink-black figure stretches up and says so proud of you., and both end with happy eyes and a pulse. The text stays: three kinds of congrats. The last card: Choose friction.
